---
title: "Variant Detection QA/QC Report"
subtitle: "`r params$ref_id`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: false
    fig_width: 14
    fig_height: 10
params:
  # These are filled in by the Snakemake rule at render time.
  # Do not edit them here — edit the rule parameters instead.
  ref_id:          "ref_A"           # Reference genome identifier
  assessment_tsvs: ""                # Comma-separated paths to assessment TSVs
  challenging_tsv: ""                # Path to .challenging.tsv (homologs + repeats)
  db_hit_files:    ""                # Comma-separated paths to mmseqs hit files
  db_names:        ""                # Comma-separated names matching db_hit_files
  genome_length:   4000000           # Approximate genome length (nt) for x-axis
  window_size:     2000              # Bin width (nt) for windowed summaries
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ── Package loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# All packages used in this report. They must be present in the conda
# environment defined in envs/r_report.yaml.
library(tidyverse)   # ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, stringr …
library(cowplot)     # plot_grid() and get_legend()
library(knitr)       # kable() for pretty tables
library(kableExtra)  # additional table formatting

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,   # hide code from the PDF
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

# ── Helper: parse a comma-separated parameter string ────────────────────────
split_param <- function(x) {
  # Returns a character vector; returns character(0) if x is blank / "".
  x <- trimws(x)
  if (nchar(x) == 0) return(character(0))
  strsplit(x, ",")[[1]]
}
```

```{r load_assessment}
# ── 1. Assessment data (one TSV per scenario that includes this ref) ─────────
#
# Each TSV has columns:
#   ref_id, seq_id, position, ref_base, alt_base, mutation_type,
#   detected, vcf_alt, vcf_freq, vcf_quality, above_threshold
#
# Multiple scenarios are stacked into one data frame; a "scenario" column is
# added so results can be compared side-by-side.

assessment_paths <- split_param(params$assessment_tsvs)

if (length(assessment_paths) == 0) {
  stop(paste("No assessment TSV paths supplied for ref_id:", params$ref_id))
}

assessment_raw <- map_dfr(assessment_paths, function(path) {
  # Derive scenario name from the file name: <scenario>_assessment.tsv
  scenario_name <- sub("_assessment\\.tsv$", "", basename(path))
  read_tsv(path, col_types = cols(
    ref_id          = col_character(),
    seq_id          = col_character(),
    position        = col_double(),
    ref_base        = col_character(),
    alt_base        = col_character(),
    mutation_type   = col_character(),
    detected        = col_logical(),
    vcf_alt         = col_character(),
    vcf_freq        = col_double(),
    vcf_quality     = col_double(),
    above_threshold = col_logical()
  )) %>%
    filter(ref_id == params$ref_id) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenario_name)
})
```

```{r load_annotation}
# ── 2. Challenging / homologous regions ─────────────────────────────────────
#
# File produced by the find_homologs rule (annotate.smk).
# 6-column BED-style TSV: chrom  start  stop  name  score  strand
# Lines starting with "#" are comments.

challenging <- read_tsv(
  params$challenging_tsv,
  comment   = "#",
  col_names = c("chrom", "start", "stop", "name", "score", "strand"),
  col_types = cols(
    chrom  = col_character(),
    start  = col_double(),
    stop   = col_double(),
    name   = col_character(),
    score  = col_character(),
    strand = col_character()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(label = "Has Close Homolog")
```

```{r load_db_hits}
# ── 3. MMseqs2 annotation hits (transposons, IS elements, etc.) ──────────────
#
# The mmseqs easy-search produces m8-format hit tables with columns:
#   query  target  pident  alnlen  mismatch  gapopen
#   qstart qend    tstart  tend    evalue    bitscore
#
# Each database supplies one file. We label each hit with its database name
# and combine them.

db_paths <- split_param(params$db_hit_files)
db_names <- split_param(params$db_names)

m8_cols <- c("query","target","pident","alnlen","mismatch","gapopen",
             "qstart","qend","tstart","tend","evalue","bitscore")

if (length(db_paths) > 0 && length(db_paths) == length(db_names)) {
  db_hits <- map2_dfr(db_paths, db_names, function(path, db_name) {
    read_tsv(path, col_names = m8_cols, col_types = cols(
      query    = col_character(),
      target   = col_character(),
      pident   = col_double(),
      alnlen   = col_double(),
      mismatch = col_double(),
      gapopen  = col_double(),
      qstart   = col_double(),
      qend     = col_double(),
      tstart   = col_double(),
      tend     = col_double(),
      evalue   = col_double(),
      bitscore = col_double()
    )) %>%
      mutate(
        db_name = db_name,
        # Classify hit type from the database name and target string.
        # "IS" databases → IS element; "Tn" in target → transposon; rest → repeat
        label = case_when(
          str_detect(target, "Tn")          ~ "Transposon",
          str_detect(db_name, "(?i)IS|ISfinder") ~ "IS Element",
          str_detect(db_name, "(?i)TE|Dfam")    ~ "Transposable Element",
          TRUE                               ~ paste("Repeat:", db_name)
        )
      )
  })
} else {
  # No database hits configured — create an empty placeholder
  db_hits <- tibble(
    query = character(), target = character(),
    qstart = double(), qend = double(),
    label = character(), db_name = character()
  )
}
```

```{r build_annotation_track}
# ── 4. Combine all annotation types into a single "problem areas" data frame ─
#
# Each row represents one annotated interval:
#   chrom  start  stop  label
#
# The query name from Prodigal has the format <contig>_<gene_index>.
# We strip the trailing gene index to recover the contig / chromosome name.

annotation_track <- bind_rows(
  # a) Repeat / TE / IS hits from mmseqs
  db_hits %>%
    select(chrom = query, start = qstart, stop = qend, label),

  # b) Homologous regions (already has chrom / start / stop / label)
  challenging %>%
    select(chrom, start, stop, label)
) %>%
  # Strip Prodigal gene index from contig name (e.g. "contig_001_3" → "contig_001")
  mutate(chrom = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", chrom)) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r compute_windowed_detection}
# ── 5. Windowed detection summary ───────────────────────────────────────────
#
# For each (scenario × contig × genomic window) bin we compute:
#   detect_pct         — fraction of expected mutations that were detected
#   above_threshold_pct — fraction also passing the quality threshold
#   n                  — number of expected mutations in this window

window_size <- as.integer(params$window_size)

windowed <- assessment_raw %>%
  arrange(seq_id, position) %>%
  mutate(window = floor(position / window_size)) %>%
  group_by(scenario, ref_id, seq_id, window) %>%
  summarise(
    detect_pct          = mean(detected,        na.rm = TRUE),
    above_threshold_pct = mean(above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    n                   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r detection_plot, fig.height=3}
# ── Plot 1: Detection rate (% mutations above quality threshold per window) ──
#
# One line per scenario so the user can compare across blending conditions.
# The x-axis is suppressed here; a shared axis is shown in the problems track.

detection_plot <- windowed %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x     = window * window_size,
    y     = above_threshold_pct * 100,
    colour = scenario,
    group  = scenario
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Detection %", colour = "Scenario") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, params$genome_length)) +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r annotation_plot, fig.height=3}
# ── Plot 2: Genomic annotation track ────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Each annotation type is drawn as a coloured horizontal segment at its own
# "level" on the y-axis.  This makes it easy to visually line up problem
# regions with detection failures in the plot above.

annotation_levels <- c(
  "Has Close Homolog",
  "Transposable Element",
  "Transposon",
  "IS Element"
)
# Include any extra database-specific labels that aren't in the preset list
extra_levels <- setdiff(unique(annotation_track$label), annotation_levels)
all_levels   <- c(annotation_levels, extra_levels)

annotation_plot <- annotation_track %>%
  mutate(level = factor(label, levels = all_levels)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = start, xend = stop, y = level, yend = level, colour = level),
    linewidth = 6
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, params$genome_length)) +
  labs(y = "", x = "Genomic position (nt)") +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r combine_plots, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
# ── Combined figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Stack detection rate (top) above the annotation track (bottom), aligned on
# the same x-axis.  The legend for the detection lines is placed to the right.

detection_legend <- get_legend(detection_plot)
detection_no_leg <- detection_plot + theme(legend.position = "none")

main_stack <- plot_grid(
  detection_no_leg,
  annotation_plot,
  ncol   = 1,
  align  = "v",       # vertically align the x-axes
  rel_heights = c(1.2, 1)
)

complete_plot <- plot_grid(
  main_stack,
  detection_legend,
  nrow       = 1,
  rel_widths = c(0.85, 0.15)
)

complete_plot
```

## Tabular summary

### Detection statistics by scenario

```{r table_by_scenario}
# ── Tabular summary 1: per-scenario detection statistics ─────────────────────
#
# Counts and percentages for each scenario that includes this reference.

summary_by_scenario <- assessment_raw %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total expected mutations` = n(),
    `Detected (any quality)`   = sum(detected,        na.rm = TRUE),
    `Above quality threshold`  = sum(above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Detection %`              = round(mean(detected,        na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    `Above-threshold %`        = round(mean(above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Scenario = scenario)

kbl(
  summary_by_scenario,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = paste("Detection summary for reference:", params$ref_id)
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    font_size     = 10
  )
```

### Detection statistics by mutation type

```{r table_by_mut_type}
# ── Tabular summary 2: breakdown by mutation type (transition / transversion) ─

summary_by_type <- assessment_raw %>%
  group_by(scenario, mutation_type) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total`             = n(),
    `Detected`          = sum(detected,        na.rm = TRUE),
    `Above threshold`   = sum(above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Detection %`       = round(mean(detected,        na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    `Above-threshold %` = round(mean(above_threshold, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Scenario = scenario, `Mutation type` = mutation_type)

kbl(
  summary_by_type,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  caption  = "Detection broken down by mutation type"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    font_size     = 10
  )
```

### Annotated regions summary

```{r table_annotation}
# ── Tabular summary 3: count and total span of each annotation category ───────

if (nrow(annotation_track) > 0) {
  annotation_summary <- annotation_track %>%
    mutate(span = abs(stop - start)) %>%
    group_by(label) %>%
    summarise(
      `Regions`   = n(),
      `Total span (nt)` = sum(span, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Mean span (nt)`  = round(mean(span, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(`Annotation type` = label)

  kbl(
    annotation_summary,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption  = paste("Annotated regions in reference:", params$ref_id)
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
      font_size     = 10
    )
} else {
  cat("No annotated regions found for this reference.\n")
}
```
